findings.observation: The complete mace remains visible with approximately 10 percent clearance at its nearest top and bottom edges and substantially more at the sides.
Exactly one complete mace is present, with no duplicate weapon or detached component.
The long gripped haft and radially flanged striking head read immediately as a one-hand flanged mace.
The flanged head is disproportionately large and massive relative to the one-hand grip and haft, making practical handling, balance, and impact recovery implausible.
Cool dark skyiron dominates the head, haft fittings, and pommel; the leather wrap remains subordinate and no second material presents a competing rank signal.
Blue energized fissures confined within layered forged flanges, together with cool hard metal response, establish skyiron beyond palette alone.
The supernatural blue behavior is restricted to narrow channels on the mace head and does not become full-object glow across the haft or grip.
The realistic painterly finish, honest wear, cold key, restrained warm rim, midnight-charcoal backdrop, and grounded floor plane follow the accepted profile.
The image satisfies all declared prohibitions except no-oversized-silhouettes: the enlarged head is too bulky for the requested practical one-hand mace.
